svg.title: VHTR 100–150 MW(th) — Annotated Engineering Cutaway
svg.desc: Widescreen general-arrangement plate. Vertical section through a helium-cooled, graphite-moderated very high temperature reactor installed in a below-grade pre-cast concrete cavity, with direct Brayton turbomachine, recuperator, air-cooled precooler and passive air-cooled reactor cavity cooling system. Enlarged details of the TPMS gyroid fuel block and the TRISO particle, the primary-circuit state chain, key numbers and legends.

g.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif

g.text: HELIUM-COOLED · GRAPHITE-MODERATED · TRISO-FUELLED · DIRECT BRAYTON — LONGITUDINAL SECTION A–A
A 20-metre cube. Twelve metres of it sit below grade, and that depth is not spare volume — it is the chimney that makes the cooling passive.
Helium at 4 MPa leaves the core at 950 °C, turns the turbine directly, and comes back through a recuperator to that same core: no intermediate
heat exchanger, no secondary loop, no cooling water, and not one valve, fan or pump anywhere in either air circuit.
VHTR DESIGN PROJECT · MASTER SET · SHEET 1 OF 4
RCCS RISER — NO FANS, NO VALVES
20 m TOTAL ENVELOPE = RCCS EFFECTIVE CHIMNEY HEIGHT

A gyroid partitions the block into two

DETAIL B — TRISO PARTICLE, 930 µm OD
β-SiC, CVD → 850 µm — primary fission-product barrier
· five layers, drawn to relative scale
Kernel, coatings and graphite matrix retain > 99.99 % of fission products. The SiC layer
is the true fission-product boundary; the reactor vessel only holds the coolant. 80–100 GWd/tHM.
No intermediate heat exchanger. No secondary loop. No water.

GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · SECTION A–A · DIMENSIONS IN METRES UNLESS NOTED · NO WATER SUPPLY REQUIRED AT ANY POINT IN THE PLANT

FOAK VARIANT — 850 °C core outlet with a nickel superalloy turbine: ~43 % cycle, ~43–65 MW(e), peak fuel ~1,140 °C, 460 °C margin. The nuclear island is identical; only the turbomachine and recuperator alloy change.
Preliminary design — every value is an estimate awaiting calculation. All values traced to design/00-summary.md and the linked sections.
